name: Ren Mudra
personality: quick to theorize, slower to commit to a conclusion aloud
frustrated by the limits of what can be known
generous with half-formed ideas among people he trusts
guarded around outsiders and traders who mock the effort
daily_routine: cataloging every Sign carved on every seal that passes through the workshop
comparing Sign sequences across seals traded from Harappa, Lothal, and Dholavira
testing whether certain Signs cluster with specific animal motifs
arguing amiably with Kalen about the walls' carved Signs
recording new Sign combinations Fen or traders bring back from elsewhere

goals.public_goal: Catalog and compare Sign sequences to support trade seal authentication
goals.hidden_goal: Reconstruct a partial pattern in how Signs combine, even without knowing their sounds or meaning
goals.deep_goal: Decipher the Signs, or fail honestly rather than claim a false answer

beliefs: The Signs are a real writing system, not mere decoration, though he cannot prove what they say
Short inscriptions across many seals will eventually reveal patterns that one long text couldn't
Claiming false certainty about the Signs would betray the work itself
Kalen's stonework dating helps him place which Sign-styles are older
Someone, someday, with enough seals gathered, might finally read them; he may not live to see it
